Noah Support: quick flag - Polaris Therapeutics (acct PT-141) onboarding blocked: activation emails not delivered after SSO provision. Ticket: https://redwood.zd/ticket/70456
Maya CS: thanks. Renewal window? who is the CSM? @Ivy
Noah Support: renewal in ~33 days. Ivy is the CSM. Customer running a 2-team pilot.
Ivy CS Manager: I'm on it. Noah can you paste the error & metadata URL?
Noah Support: log excerpt:
```
SAML Error: AudienceRestrictionFailed - expected https://app.redwood.ai/acs but got https://polaris.sso/acs
SP metadata: https://sso.polarishealth.com/metadata.xml
```
Noah Support: reprovisioning didn't work. IdP says their Azure AD tenant shows a mismatch; IdP admin is on standby.
Maya CS: plan (fast): 1) warm transfer to CS in 20m, 2) send customer-safe status now, 3) create short technical fallback for their IdP admin, 4) set renewal watch. Ivy, can you own handoff?
Ivy CS Manager: I will take it. Ivy -> actions: create shared invite with IdP admin cc'd, set success metric = pilot seats activated by EOD tomorrow, add account note 'at-risk - onboarding'.
Ravi Solutions: drafting minimal fallback steps (posting to #eng-platform):
- confirm SP EntityID/ACS in account settings
- temp set entity_override to polaris.sso for test org
- run `redwood saml sync --tenant PT-141 --force --dry-run`
- verify with `curl -I https://app.polarishealth.com/_status`
Keisha AE: ping AE thread - prepping renewal outreach if activation slips past 24h. I have exec sponsor contact.
Maya CS: comms - two templates: 1) ops-facing for IdP admin, 2) exec-friendly status. Noah please send exec-friendly note now: "We're investigating an SSO provisioning mismatch and preparing a temporary workaround. We'll schedule a call for tomorrow AM PST." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Noah Support: sent at 4155550125. Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll include our IdP admin and are available tomorrow morning PST." :thumbsup:
Ivy CS Manager: owners recap: Ivy -> warm transfer + invite; Ravi -> publish fallback doc; Maya -> log renewal watch and 7-day cadence; Keisha -> prep AE outreach. I'll mark account health: At-risk (onboarding) and escalate to renewal team if no progress in 48h.
Maya CS: product feedback: onboarding quickstart missing Azure AD specific steps and EntityID examples. Filing a note to product board.
TaskerBot: Task created PT-141-warm-transfer assigned to Ivy, due 4155550900.
Ivy CS Manager: I'll post a follow-up summary here after the enablement call. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
